experiment: EXP3 — placement comparison against a plain-source control
claimPlacedInEveryVariant: Returns the sum of a and b.
correctionLog: v1 extracted a comment that did not exist and compared null==null (vacuous true). v2 authors the claim explicitly and asserts the comment was found before trusting the comparison.

P0_plain_source_control.reason: nothing to be wrong about — and nothing that can ever become right

P1_comment_in_source.description: meaning authored inside a doc comment in the source file
P1_comment_in_source.commentStillReads: Returns the sum of a and b.
P1_comment_in_source.reason: the comment is carried along by the very edit that falsifies it, and nothing inside it records the digest it was written against, so no checker can tell a reader the claim was authored for a different source
P1_comment_in_source.detectsUnenforcedPreconditionHow: only because the author wrote the honesty note themselves — a property of this author, not a guarantee the placement provides
P1_comment_in_source.postMutationStatus: the file still asserts "Returns the sum of a and b" while returning a product

P2_digest_bound_sidecar.description: generated metadata in a separate file, pinned to the source sha256
P2_digest_bound_sidecar.detectsMutationHow: the pinned digest no longer matches the file on disk, so the sidecar is provably stale and a checker can refuse to serve it — no execution required
P2_digest_bound_sidecar.detectsUnenforcedPreconditionHow: a digest proves WHICH source a claim was written against, never whether the claim is true of that source. Binding is not verification.
P2_digest_bound_sidecar.cost: a second artifact that can drift from the source and needs its own lifecycle

headline.finding: Placement determines what failure is DETECTABLE, not what is true. A comment can carry a self-deprecating honesty note but cannot signal its own staleness; a digest-bound sidecar can signal staleness but cannot make a false claim true; the plain control is never wrong and never right.
headline.consequence: No placement alone yields a truthful self-describing file. The smallest credible path needs the witness, not the placement: every claim needs an executed probe AND a source digest, because EXP3 shows digest binding is not verification and EXP2 shows type-level descriptions are blind to body changes.
